title: Inference RPC
description: Wire format between the ml-inference HTTP service (:8080) and the backend InferenceClient. Versioned interface — changes require a contract update (RULE 6/CONTRIBUTING).

mu.description: Predicted temperature mean per depth, flattened [depth][lat*lon] row-major (lat outer). null encodes land cells. len(mu[d]) == len(latitude) * len(longitude).

log_var.description: Predicted log-variance per depth, same layout as mu.

latitude.description: Ascending latitude centers of the predicted grid (length matches mu's first spatial axis; the backend builds ocean-map coordinates from this — never guessed).

longitude.description: Longitude centers of the predicted grid (length matches mu's second spatial axis).

dates.description: Optional: dates covered by the tensor store (health response).
